name: @nanobpm/bojtos
description: Bojtos — the in-browser BPMN demo framework (ADR 0043). Monorepo for @nanobpm/bojtos-kit (framework-agnostic scenario runner over @nanobpm/engine-wasm) and @nanobpm/bojtos-react (the useBojtos hook + live diagram).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @nanobpm/bojtos-kit && npm run build --workspace @nanobpm/bojtos-react
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @nanobpm/bojtos-kit && npm run typecheck --workspace @nanobpm/bojtos-kit && npm run typecheck --workspace @nanobpm/bojtos-react
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:ci --workspace @nanobpm/bojtos-kit && npm run test:ci --workspace @nanobpm/bojtos-react
